column1: # Cell counts of the designs whose line sheets are on file
# Sources: the makers' own specification pages, except where noted
# Why this file exists. How densely a real wing is attached on its front row
# (its front-row anchors over the ribs of a half-wing) needs the cell count,
# and eleven of the twenty designs with line sheets here had none on file.
# The anchor search was bounded by "0.56 to 0.91", measured on six Ozone
# designs, and three of those six rib counts were wrong (34, 33 and 27 ribs
# for wings of 65, 71 and 62 cells). The twenty designs run 0.28 to 0.94.
# Every size of every design here has the same number of cells, so one count
# The nine designs already in size-families.tsv or niviuk-spec.tsv are listed
# with that file as their source. The unit suite holds the two to each other,
# so this file cannot drift from them.
# Ribs on a half-wing are floor(cells / 2) + 1: an even count puts a rib on
# the centreline, which both halves share, and an odd count puts a cell
# across it (the Alpina 5, Lynx 2, Hook 6, Lyght, Vibe GT, Summit X, Torre).
# The PHI sheet is the Allegro X-Alps 21; the count is the Allegro light's,
# from the same maker's table. The line sheet's own rib numbers (2 to 36 on
# the A row) agree with 37 ribs a side.
